programmes.d: When Frank learns his wife is going to die, Vinnie uses some missing O.C.B. funds to enable her to get a lifesaving transplant.
Rachel goes into labor while Tony is out on a ledge trying to stop a troubled cop from jumping.
Rachel witnesses a robbery-murder, but “reasonable doubt” releases the suspect she positively IDs.
A rape victim takes matters into her own hands when diplomatic immunity shields her attacker. Meanwhile, Tony's new baby is giving him many sleepless nights.
As doctors prepare to operate on the paralyzed McCall, Hunter races against time to exonerate himself and find whoever is killing potential witnesses in a deadly prostitution case.
After learning the circumstances leading up to the murder of a notorious Latino crime boss, Hunter and McCall face an ethical dilemma: whether to arrest the killer or let him go free.
When Hunter helps a distressed war buddy look for the kidnappers of his mail-order bride, the investigation leads Hunter and McCall to murder and double-cross.
Vinnie has no choice but to come out from behind his O.C.B. badge and face the chilling accusations of mobster Sonny Steelgrave — the friend he was forced to betray.
Vinnie and Frank plan to use a record company OCB they have to get into the corrupt music business.
Corrupt music mogul Winston Newquay tries to buy out Vinnie's Dead Dog Records, but it instead opts to merge with Isaac Twine's company, Shakala.
Tony suspects a "retiring" crime figure is behind a murder frame-up.
After Tony's expensive new automobile is stolen from him at gunpoint, he and Cyd clash over the best way to capture Eastbridge's busiest carjackers.
Tony joins a video-dating service when he suspects one of the users is a murderous thief. Also, Stan tries to protect Carmela from a clairvoyant's curse.
